description: This Java source file defines the class SmwConfirmationTableModel, which is a table model used in a confirmation step within an Android SDK wizard. It manages display and editing of package installation, update, and removal actions, including rendering and user interaction logic.

classes.name: SmwConfirmationTableModel
classes.description: A table model for displaying package actions (install, update, remove) in a confirmation dialog within the Android SDK wizard.

classes.name: LineType
classes.description: Enumeration representing the type of a line in the table (HEADER, REMOVE, UPDATE, INSTALL).

classes.name: LineInfo
classes.description: Data class representing a row in the table, holding information about package actions and their types.

classes.name: LabelColumnInfo
classes.description: Column info class for rendering the label of each line based on its type.

classes.name: InstallColumnInfo
classes.description: Column info class for the checkbox indicating whether to accept/install a package.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in the table.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: getColumnInfo
methods.description: Returns the ColumnInfo object for a given column index.

methods.name: getObjectAt
methods.description: Returns the LineInfo object at a specific row.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific cell in the table.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Determines if a cell is editable.

methods.name: setValueAt
methods.description: Sets the value for a specific cell.

methods.name: fillModel
methods.description: Populates the table model with selected package actions, organizing them into install/update/remove sections.
